The regex patterns `REPLACE_LP` and `REPLACE_LEFT_BRACKET` use `BEFORE_REGEX = "([\\s,])*"`, which matches zero or more spaces or commas. Because it allows zero characters, these patterns will match the strings "LP" or "OPENING_BRACKET" even when they are embedded within other words (e.g., "HELP" would be transformed into "HE'('" if it occurs at the end of a string). To ensure only standalone token names are replaced, consider using word boundaries (`\b`) or negative lookarounds to ensure the match is not preceded by an alphanumeric character.
